senses.definition: To the degree or extent that.
senses.example: as far as the eye can see
wordFamily: as far as one can tell

senses.definition: Used without any completion, usually to imply "to the degree or extent that ... is/are concerned".
senses.example: As far as the policies and procedures under which these companies operate, we keep a very close eye on that.
wordFamily: as far as one can tell

senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see as, far, as.
senses.example: as far as the next town
wordFamily: as far as one can tell

senses.definition: With respect to; as relates to.
senses.example: As far as financing, there will be no problems.
wordFamily: as far as one can tell
as far as one can tell
